input: Join /data/orders.csv and /data/products.csv on product_id. For each category, compute the total revenue (quantity * price). Print 'category: total_revenue' sorted by revenue descending.

tool_calls: head -n 5 /data/orders.csv; echo '---'; head -n 5 /data/products.csv; command -v awk; command -v ruby; command -v node; command -v csvkit

awk -F, 'FNR==1 {next} NR==FNR {category[$1]=$3; price[$1]=$4; next} $2 in category {revenue[category[$2]] += $3 * price[$2]} END {for (c in revenue) printf "%s: %.2f\n", c, revenue[c]}' /data/products.csv /data/orders.csv | sort -t: -k2,2nr
